name: POLYMALTOSED IRON / FOLIC ACID 100MG/800MCG 30 TABLETS
description: The combination of iron polymaltose and folic acid at concentrations of 100 mg and 800 mcg, respectively, in a 30-tablet presentation, is an anti-anemic supplement. It is used to prevent and treat iron and folate deficiencies, which can cause anemia. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
